lines.en: label utamaid20:
scene nightsky
It’s cold.
lines.zh: 天很冷。

lines.en: But you’ve heard that before.
lines.zh: 不过这话你已经听我说过了。

lines.en: You’ve heard virtually everything before, haven’t you?
lines.zh: 你几乎什么都听我说过了，不是吗？

lines.en: One of the downsides of sharing your thoughts with people is that it’s very easy to lose track of who you’ve told what or how many times you’ve said {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: 把自己的想法分享给别人，坏处之一就是：你很容易就记不清什么话对谁说过、又说过了{i}多少遍{/i}。

lines.en: I think this to myself, for what may be the millionth time (Even I have lost count) and wonder who it is I’m referring to.
lines.zh: 我在心里想着这件事，也许是第一百万次了（连我自己都数不清了），同时纳闷我说的「你」到底指的是谁。

lines.en: Who am I sharing these thoughts with?
lines.zh: 我到底在跟谁分享这些想法？

lines.en: I look up at the stars and hope, for some reason, that it starts to snow.
lines.zh: 我抬头望向星空，不知为何，盼着天能下起雪来。

lines.en: Maybe it’s just because I’m looking for a change of scenery.
lines.zh: 也许只是因为我想换个风景看看。

lines.en: Or maybe it’s something a little more confusing in nature.
lines.zh: 又或者，是某种性质上更让人费解的东西。

lines.en: Like there’s something I associate the snow with that will subconsciously wipe away any and all of the lingering negativity coursing through my veins.
lines.zh: 比如说，我把雪和某样东西联系在了一起，而它能下意识地抹去我血管里流淌的所有挥之不去的负面情绪。

lines.en: I think more about veins and the circulatory system.
lines.zh: 我又多想了想血管和循环系统。

lines.en: Of how our bodies are machines.
lines.zh: 想着我们的身体其实就是机器。

lines.en: Of how each and every part of us just naturally falls into place as the result of a man cumming inside of a woman.
lines.zh: 想着我们身上的每一个部件，都只是男人射在女人体内之后自然归位的结果。

lines.en: And I realize that nothing in this world is really strange at all when entire existences and consciousnesses are being formed as the result of rough doggystyle sex in bathrooms.
lines.zh: 而我也意识到，既然一整个存在、一整个意识都是在卫生间里粗暴的后入式性交中形成的，那这世上还真没什么称得上奇怪的东西。

lines.en: I think more about veins and the circulatory system.
lines.zh: 我又多想了想血管和循环系统。

lines.en: Of how it’s all just a bunch of wires, not much different from what it would look like if you were to tear open one of your walls.
lines.zh: 想着那一切不过是一堆线路，跟你把自家一堵墙拆开后看到的样子没什么两样。

lines.en: My mind races, but moves not even half as effectively as a horse who breaks its leg at the midpoint of a race and needs to be put down.
lines.zh: 我的思绪在狂奔，可效率还不到一匹在比赛中途摔断腿、需要被安乐死的赛马的一半。

lines.en: I think of splaying myself out on the concrete and letting someone put {i}me{/i} down while a group of children watch on in shock.
lines.zh: 我想象自己四肢摊开躺在水泥地上，让什么人把{i}我{/i}也了结了，而一群孩子在一旁震惊地看着。

lines.en: But I stop when I realize that I have so much left to live for.
lines.zh: 可当我意识到自己还有那么多值得活下去的东西时，我停下了。

lines.en: I stop when I realize I have not yet begun to live at all.
lines.zh: 当我意识到自己根本还没真正开始活过，我停下了。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: You okay, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 您还好吗，Sensei？

lines.en: scene utakaraoke1
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : You kinda just walked up to me and Osako and started lookin’ at the sky.
lines.zh: : 您刚才就这么走到我和 Osako 面前，然后开始盯着天看。

lines.en: : Has Io been sneakin’ you some of her pills? Do we need to schedule an intervention?
lines.zh: : Io 是不是偷偷给您吃她的药了？我们要不要安排一次干预？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I’m fine. What are you doing outside, though?
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己挺好的。不过你们在外面干什么？

lines.en: : Aren’t you two supposed to be at work?
lines.zh: : 你们俩不是应该在上班吗？

lines.en: scene utakaraoke2
: I already told you when you first showed up...
lines.zh: : 您刚来的时候我就跟您说过了呀……

lines.en: : We close at 10:00 and it’s like 10:30 right now.
lines.zh: : 我们十点打烊，现在都十点半了。

lines.en: : When did it get so late? I feel like it was the afternoon just a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 什么时候这么晚了？我明明觉得几分钟前还是下午啊。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke3
: Ah! Dementia!
lines.zh: : 啊！老年痴呆！

lines.en: : It’s grandpa Ushibori all over again!
lines.zh: : 这简直是 Ushibori 爷爷的翻版！

lines.en: : Who am I, Sensei?! Tell me you remember me!
lines.zh: : 我是谁，Sensei？！快说您还记得我！

lines.en: : You are my girlfriend and personal maid.
lines.zh: : 你是我的女朋友兼专属女仆。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke4
: Phew...it looks like you're okay after all.
lines.zh: : 呼……看来您还是没问题的。

lines.en: : Can you two take your flirting somewhere else? I’m starting to get a headache.
lines.zh: : 你们俩能不能换个地方调情？我开始头疼了。

lines.en: : Osako-chan is just sad that her girlfriend isn’t here to pick her up yet.
lines.zh: : Osako 酱只是难过，因为她的女朋友还没来接她。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Osako. Uta and I will hang out with you and keep you safe until she gets here.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Osako。在她来之前，我和 Uta 会陪着你，保护你的安全。

lines.en: : You are...aware that I’m a fifth degree black belt, right? I could hold my own against basically everyone in this city.
lines.zh: : 你……知道我是空手道黑带五段吧？这座城市里基本上没人是我的对手。

lines.en: : We will protect you. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我们会保护你的。别担心。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke5
: You know, sometimes, I wish that rich girl {i}did{/i} buy the dojo.
lines.zh: : 说真的，有时候我真希望那个富家千金{i}当初真的{/i}把道场买下来。

lines.en: : So, whatcha gonna do now that ya can’t be pampered by Uta-chan and stuff your face with cupcakes for the rest of the night?
lines.zh: : 那么，接下来一整晚都没法让 Uta 酱伺候、没法塞一嘴的纸杯蛋糕了，您打算干什么呀？

lines.en: : Probably follow you around like some kind of stalker or something.
lines.zh: : 大概像个跟踪狂似的跟着你什么的吧。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke6
: Uhh...hahah...
lines.zh: : 呃……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : If you want the realistic answer, I’ll probably just go home and watch porn or something.
lines.zh: : 想要现实点的答案的话，我大概就回家看点黄片什么的。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke7
: Here’s an idea! How about you come out with me instead?
lines.zh: : 我有个主意！您不如跟我一起出去玩？

lines.en: : I obviously can’t do for you what those sexy porn ladies would do, but we can at least find our own non-sexual ways to have fun!
lines.zh: : 那些性感的黄片女郎能替您做的事，我显然做不到，但我们至少能找到属于我们自己的、不涉性的快乐方式！

lines.en: : Non-sexual fun is an oxymoron.
lines.zh: : 「不涉性的快乐」本身就是个矛盾的说法。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like a certain somebody has never experienced karaoke before.
lines.zh: : 听这话，某个人八成从来没体验过卡拉 OK。

lines.en: : Every experience I have with karaoke is bad.
lines.zh: : 我对卡拉 OK 的每一次体验都很糟。

lines.en: : Well, looks like we’re gonna have to break the streak!
lines.zh: : 那看来我们得把这条连败纪录给破了！

lines.en: : This is what I normally do after getting off work anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我下班以后通常都是这么过的。

lines.en: : You leave the maid cafe at 10:30 to go do karaoke by yourself?
lines.zh: : 你十点半从女仆咖啡厅出来，然后一个人去唱卡拉 OK？

lines.en: : I’m not always alone! Osako comes with me sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我也不总是一个人呀！Osako 有时候会跟我一起去。

lines.en: : Does she now?...
scene utakaraoke8
: Don’t sound so surprised about it...
lines.zh: : 别说得这么惊讶好吗……

lines.en: : Unfortunately, Osako-chan’s gotta get home and give her woman some of that sweet, sweet lovin’, so I was gonna go alone tonight.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，Osako 酱得回家给她家那位献上甜甜蜜蜜的爱了，所以今晚我本来打算一个人去。

lines.en: : Have fun, Uta. I’m going to go back to Osako’s place and watch the whole loving thing.
lines.zh: : Uta，祝你玩得开心。我要去 Osako 家，把整个过程看个遍。

lines.en: : Which is more than she can say since she apparently likes being blindfolded and-
lines.zh: : 这可是她自己说不出口的，毕竟她好像挺喜欢被蒙着眼睛，然后——

lines.en: scene utakaraoke9
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : I guess I’ll tag along too. We can watch ‘em together as long as we stay on opposite sides of the room.
lines.zh: : 那我也跟着去好了。只要我们待在房间的两头，就可以一起看。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : Fuck off. We’re probably just going to watch a movie and fall asleep anyway.
lines.zh: : 滚蛋。我们大概也就是看个电影然后睡过去而已。

lines.en: : Don’t be like that. Wakana looks like she could use a good orgasm or two to be brought back to life.
lines.zh: : 别这样嘛。Wakana 看起来需要来一两次痛快的高潮才能活过来。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke10
: She’s plenty alive and plenty satisfied, thank you very much!
lines.zh: : 她活得好好的、也满足得很，多谢关心！

lines.en: : Sounds to me like Osako-chan could use a good rubdown herself, right Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我听着倒像是 Osako 酱自己需要好好按一按，对吧 Sensei？

lines.en: scene utakaraoke11
: I...I’m going for a walk!
lines.zh: : 我……我出去走走！

lines.en: : And if Wakana shows up, don’t you dare try hitching a ride back to our place or I’ll kick both of your asses!
lines.zh: : 还有，要是 Wakana 来了，你们敢蹭车回我们家试试，我把你们俩的屁股都踢开花！

lines.en: : Osako, really? Karate is supposed to be used for self-defense, not picking on people weaker than you.
lines.zh: : Osako，说真的？空手道是用来防身的，不是用来欺负比你弱的人的。

lines.en: : I’m...defending my honor. Now, goodbye.
lines.zh: : 我……我这是在捍卫我的名誉。行了，再见。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke12
Osako leaves and suddenly it’s just Uta and me.
lines.zh: Osako 走了，转眼间就只剩下 Uta 和我两个人。

lines.en: She wastes no time in pressing the issue at hand, however, as we’re immediately discussing the probability of karaoke again.
lines.zh: 不过她没浪费一点时间，我们立刻又讨论起了去唱卡拉 OK 的可能性。

lines.en: : So, you gonna come with me? Or are you gonna let a defenseless lil’ girl like me wander around Kumon-mi all by herself?
lines.zh: : 那么，您要跟我来吗？还是说，您忍心让我这么一个手无缚鸡之力的小姑娘一个人在 Kumon-mi 街头乱晃？

lines.en: : You’ve already said that’s something you do all the time.
lines.zh: : 你都说了，这是你经常做的事。

lines.en: : Doesn’t mean I wouldn’t be happy to have a big strong man like yourself to protect my pint-size body from bein’ snatched up and thrown into a van.
lines.zh: : 这也不代表，有您这样高大强壮的男人护着我这迷你小身板，免得被人一把抓进面包车里，我会不开心啊。

lines.en: : I’ll gladly accompany you. But know now that I’ll just be awkwardly staring at you as you sing for the entire night.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意陪你。不过你先搞清楚，我大概只会尴尬地盯着你唱一整晚。

lines.en: : You think I’m not used to you staring at me by now? Come on, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 您以为到现在我还不习惯被您盯着看吗？得了吧，Sensei。

lines.en: : You’ve barely taken your eyes off of me since I strolled into[school] that fateful winter day.
lines.zh: : 自从那个命中注定的冬日，我走进[school]的那一刻起，您的目光就没怎么离开过我。

lines.en: : You know, when you were hanging out with your girlfriend Maya at her locker.
lines.zh: : 就是您当时跟您的女朋友 Maya 在她储物柜那边腻乎的时候。

lines.en: : Actually, wanna invite her to karaoke with us?
lines.zh: : 话说，要不要把她也叫来一起唱？

lines.en: : I’ll even sing some cute lil’ love songs to get you two in the mood!
lines.zh: : 我还可以唱几首可爱的小情歌，好让你俩进入状态！

lines.en: : If there is any song that will put Maya in “the mood,” I highly implore you teach it to me.
lines.zh: : 要是真有哪首歌能让 Maya「进入状态」，我强烈恳求你教给我。

lines.en: : That I can do, Sensei! But not if we’re out here.
lines.zh: : 这个我办得到，Sensei！不过在这儿可不行。

lines.en: : The karaoke place is on the way back to the dorm, so just stick with me and you’ll be learnin’ how to woo your lady in no time at all!
lines.zh: : 那家卡拉 OK 就在回宿舍的路上，所以您只要跟着我，转眼就能学会怎么哄您的女人开心！

lines.en: scene black
Uta begins to march away from the gate outside of the maid cafe and the two of us start heading over to the karaoke place.
lines.zh: Uta 迈开步子离开女仆咖啡厅门外那道门，我们俩便朝那家卡拉 OK 走去。

lines.en: I’m not sure if it will be the same one I’ve been to with Ami and the others before but, if it {i}is{/i}, I really hope Ayane isn’t there.
lines.zh: 我不确定是不是之前跟 Ami 她们去过的那家，不过如果{i}是{/i}的话，我真希望 Ayane 不在。

lines.en: There’s only so much Despacito one person can take, and I have already greatly surpassed my lifetime allowance of it.
lines.zh: 一个人能承受的《Despacito》是有限的，而我早就把一辈子的额度给用超了。

lines.en: Uta and I remain close together, just an inch or two apart, as we wander down the streets.
lines.zh: 我们在街上走着，Uta 和我挨得很近，只隔着一两英寸。

lines.en: I think of veins and the circulatory system once again, but in an exponentially more suggestive way this time.
lines.zh: 我又一次想到了血管和循环系统，只不过这一次，想法带上了指数级增长的暧昧意味。

lines.en: I can’t be blamed for this, though.
lines.zh: 不过这也不能怪我。

lines.en: Karaoke this late at night with just one guy and one girl typically only means one thing.
lines.zh: 深更半夜，一男一女两个人去唱卡拉 OK，通常只意味着一件事。

lines.en: And even though Uta may only be in this to sing and get some of the energy out of her system, I’m sure she knows how it’ll look too.
lines.zh: 就算 Uta 只是想唱唱歌、把体内的精力发泄掉，我敢肯定她也知道这在别人眼里会是什么样子。

lines.en: And yet we walk.
lines.zh: 但我们还是这么走着。

lines.en: And, after ten minutes or so, we arrive at our destination...
lines.zh: 大约十分钟之后，我们到了目的地……

lines.en: scene utakaraoke13

I’m forcibly dragged into a private karaoke booth as soon as the two of us reach the place and, just as things start to look like they’re going to get exciting, Uta grabs a microphone and breaks out into song.
lines.zh: 我们一到地方，我就被硬拽进了一间卡拉 OK 包厢，而就在事情看起来要变得刺激起来的时候，Uta 抓起麦克风，开口唱了起来。

lines.en: I can already tell in just the several minutes we’ve been here that it’s something she’s done hundreds of times before.
lines.zh: 才来了几分钟，我就看得出来，这是她做过上百次的事了。

lines.en: Probably thousands if we’re taking the whole time loop thing into consideration and-
lines.zh: 要是把整个时间循环也算上，大概是几千次——

lines.en: Actually, that wouldn’t be right, would it?
lines.zh: 不过，这么说也不对吧？

lines.en: I know she worked at the maid cafe before transferring into [kumon_mi_high], but I highly doubt she was doing something like this before commuting all the way back across town.
lines.zh: 我知道她在转学到[kumon_mi_high]之前就在那家女仆咖啡厅打工了，但我很怀疑，在她还得来回横跨整座城市通勤的时候，就已经在干这种事了。

lines.en: Either way, I awkwardly stand around as she cycles through different pop songs and, of course, she also has somewhat of a dance routine for each one.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我尴尬地站在一旁，看她一首接一首地换着流行歌，当然，每首歌她都还配了点专属的舞蹈动作。

lines.en: It’s a lot different than when Ami and the others come here but, even though her voice isn’t perfect, her energy and presence are mildly exhilarating.
lines.zh: 这跟 Ami 她们来的时候大不一样，不过尽管她的嗓音算不上完美，她的活力和存在感还是让人有点上头。

lines.en: If I was into idols (Sorry, Niki) and other stuff like that, I’d probably find myself falling for her right about now.
lines.zh: 如果我对偶像（抱歉了，Niki）那类东西感兴趣的话，大概这会儿已经为她倾心了。

lines.en: The only thing is, I’ve kind of already cemented Uta as an ideal woman in my eyes and I would not want to sleep with her any less even if she was absolutely horrible at singing and dancing.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，我早就把 Uta 当成了我心中的理想女性，就算她唱歌跳舞差到极点，我想跟她上床的念头也不会少半分。

lines.en: Thankfully, she isn’t.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，她并不差。

lines.en: So...that’s just a plus I guess.
lines.zh: 所以……这个权当是加分项吧。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke14
Every once in a while, she’ll make eye contact with me and try to get me excited, but...
lines.zh: 她时不时就会跟我眼神对上，试图挑起我的兴致，不过……

lines.en: I am me.
lines.zh: 我就是我。

lines.en: And excitement is, unfortunately, not a trait I inherited from whoever it was that decided to have rough doggystyle sex and lay out the wires inside of my body.
lines.zh: 而遗憾的是，我并没有从那个决定来一场粗暴后入式性交、并在我体内铺好线路的人身上，继承到「兴奋」这个特质。

lines.en: I {i}am{/i} at least respectful enough to stand, though.
lines.zh: 不过{i}至少{/i}我还算有点礼貌，肯站着。

lines.en: Also, it gives me a better view of Uta because she tends to bounce a lot when she dances and...I’m sure you can guess what that means.
lines.zh: 而且站着看 Uta 的视野也更好，因为她跳舞的时候总是一晃一晃的……我敢肯定你猜得到那意味着什么。

lines.en: Sidenote: I really wish she wasn’t actually a prude and that she shared my same opinions on the idea of fun and its correlation to sexual contact.
lines.zh: 顺便一提：我真希望她其实没那么保守，也希望她在「什么叫好玩」以及它跟性接触的关联上，跟我看法一致。

lines.en: But alas.
lines.zh: 可惜啊。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke15
: Sing with me, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 跟我一起唱嘛，Sensei！

lines.en: : I don’t know this song.
lines.zh: : 我不会这首歌。

lines.en: : Who cares?! The words are right there on the screen!
lines.zh: : 谁管那个？！歌词不就打在屏幕上嘛！

lines.en: : I don’t sing.
lines.zh: : 我不唱歌。

lines.en: : What if I let ya put your arm around me? That enough to get you to act happy?
lines.zh: : 那要是我让您搂着我呢？这样够不够让您表现得开心点？

lines.en: : Just have fun on your own and I’ll keep watching.
lines.zh: : 你自己玩得开心就好，我就一直看着。

lines.en: : You’re not even looking, though!
lines.zh: : 可您根本都没在看啊！

lines.en: : If I look at you, I’ll have a harder time saying no.
lines.zh: : 我要是看着你，就很难说出「不」了。

lines.en: : You’re annoyingly cute.
lines.zh: : 你可恶地可爱。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke16
: Sing!
: No.
lines.zh: : 不唱。

lines.en: Uta grabs my chin and tilts my face toward her, making it incredibly hard to not grab her and not only ruin her song but break several of this establishment’s rules in the process.
lines.zh: Uta 一把捏住我的下巴，把我的脸扳向她，这让我极难忍住不一把抓住她——那样不仅会毁了她这首歌，还会顺带破了这家店的好几条规矩。

lines.en: : Sing!!
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because it’s fun!
lines.zh: : 因为好玩啊！

lines.en: : You’ve gotta smile, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 您得笑一笑啊，Sensei！

lines.en: : I’m perfectly content with just watching.
lines.zh: : 我就这么看着，已经心满意足了。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke17
: Sing, damn it!
lines.zh: : 唱啊，该死的！

lines.en: : Karaoke is bad.
lines.zh: : 卡拉 OK 是坏东西。

lines.en: : You will have fun with me and you will like it!
lines.zh: : 你会跟我在一起玩得开心，而且你会喜欢的！

lines.en: : Stop it.
lines.zh: : 别闹了。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke18
: AHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : You’re messing up the song.
lines.zh: : 你把歌给唱乱了。

lines.en: : You don’t care about the song! You don’t care about Uta-chan! You don’t care about anything!
lines.zh: : 您根本不在乎这首歌！您根本不在乎 Uta 酱！您什么都不在乎！

lines.en: : Uta, I’m starting to lose balance.
lines.zh: : Uta，我快站不稳了。

lines.en: : I’m starting to lose {i}patience!{/i} I’m on my fifth song and I haven’t even heard a peep outta you yet!
lines.zh: : 我快失去{i}耐心{/i}了！都第五首歌了，我连您一个字都没听见！

lines.en: : Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: scene utakaraoke19
: How do you expect to ever marry me if you can’t even sing a little song?! It’s not that hard!
lines.zh: : 您连一首小歌都不肯唱，还指望有朝一日能娶我？！这又有多难啊！

lines.en: : I am going to fall now.
lines.zh: : 我要摔倒了。

lines.en: : I’m 4’11! Are you really about to be taken down by a girl my size?!
lines.zh: : 我才一米五！您真的要被我这个头的小姑娘给撂倒吗？！

lines.en: : Yup. Brace for impact.
lines.zh: : 是的。准备迎接撞击吧。

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei！

lines.en: scene black
Now, I know what you’re thinking...and I’m sure it’s exactly how Uta put it.
lines.zh: 我知道你在想什么……而且我敢肯定，跟 Uta 说的一模一样。

lines.en: And yes, I did get taken down by a girl 100lbs lighter and an entire foot shorter than me.
lines.zh: 没错，我确实被一个比我轻一百磅、矮整整一英尺的女孩给撂倒了。

lines.en: But A: My foot had gotten wrapped around a wire. And B: Why would I try and prevent this?
lines.zh: 不过，第一：我的脚被一根电线缠住了。第二：我干嘛要去阻止这种事发生？

lines.en: Because now the two of us look like this.
lines.zh: 因为现在，我们俩成了这副样子。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke20
: Hey.
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Me?
: Yeah.
: I’m...fine.
lines.zh: : 我……没事。

lines.en: : You kinda broke my fall.
lines.zh: : 是您替我垫了一下。

lines.en: : It appears that I did.
lines.zh: : 看起来是这样的。

lines.en: : Thanks for...protecting me?
lines.zh: : 谢谢您……保护我？

lines.en: : No problem.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: : I kind of warned you that this was about to happen, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我好像提醒过你，这会发生的。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t have happened if you’d have just sung.
lines.zh: : 要是您肯唱，就不会发生这种事了。

lines.en: : All things considered, I’m kind of glad I didn’t.
lines.zh: : 综合来看，我倒有点庆幸自己没唱。

lines.en: : You’re...breakin’ a bunch of Uta-chan’s rules right now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，您现在……正在违反 Uta 酱的好几条规矩呢。

lines.en: : You’re the one on top of me.
lines.zh: : 可是压在我身上的人是你。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke21
: Huh.
: I guess I am.
lines.zh: : 好像是这么回事。

lines.en: : And...you’re okay with that?
lines.zh: : 那么……你这样也没关系？

lines.en: : Uta?
lines.zh: : Uta？

lines.en: scene utakaraoke22
: Ah! S-Sorry! I just...
lines.zh: : 啊！对、对不起！我只是……

lines.en: : The...blood rushed to my head from the fall!
lines.zh: : 刚才摔的那一跤……血都涌到头上去了！

lines.en: : I’ll get up!
lines.zh: : 我这就起来！

lines.en: scene black
Uta quickly hops off of me and pats herself down to straighten out her clothes.
lines.zh: Uta 赶紧从我身上跳下来，拍了拍身子把衣服理顺。

lines.en: The song that had been playing comes to an end and fills the room with silence.
lines.zh: 原本在放的那首歌放完了，房间里顿时一片安静。

lines.en: Then, after a moment of respite for each of us, we quietly sit down on the couch and wait for the awkwardness to fade.
lines.zh: 接着，各自喘息了片刻之后，我们默默在沙发上坐下，等着这份尴尬散去。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke23
: So-
lines.zh: : 那么——

lines.en: : What’s that phrase about the elephant in the room again?
lines.zh: : 那句关于「房间里的大象」的话是怎么说的来着？

lines.en: : I believe that would be “the elephant in the room.”
lines.zh: : 我想，应该就是「房间里的大象」吧。

lines.en: : We should probably talk about that.
lines.zh: : 我们大概该聊聊那件事。

lines.en: : You mean how you got all red and looked like you were about to kiss me just now?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你刚才满脸通红、一副要亲上来的样子？

lines.en: scene utakaraoke24
: Uhh...yeah.
: You clearly didn’t buy the blood thing, so...I figure I’ve gotta explain myself or stuff will get weird.
lines.zh: : 您显然没信「血涌上头」那套说辞，所以……我想我得解释一下，不然事情会变奇怪。

lines.en: : Why didn't you just do it?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不干脆亲下去？

lines.en: scene utakaraoke25
: Sensei, I understand that you may be head over heels in love with me, but please don’t mistake my moment of confusion for the desire to smooch you.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我知道您可能已经为我神魂颠倒了，但请您别把我那一刻的恍惚，误当成想亲您的念头。

lines.en: : I just needed a second to figure out what the right move for everyone was.
lines.zh: : 我只是需要一点时间，想清楚对所有人来说正确的做法是什么。

lines.en: : Everyone?
lines.zh: : 所有人？

lines.en: : But we’re the only two people here. No one would have known if anything happened.
lines.zh: : 可这儿就我们两个人。就算发生了什么，也没人会知道。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke26
: Bet you’re regretting missing that once in a lifetime opportunity, huh? We got really close to doing something really naughty.
lines.zh: : 您是不是在后悔错过了一辈子才有一次的机会？我们差点就干了件特别坏的事呢。

lines.en: : I didn't realize it was up to me to make the first move there.
lines.zh: : 我可不知道那事儿该由我来先动手。

lines.en: : Also, I don’t consider kissing “really naughty.”
lines.zh: : 而且，我可不觉得接吻算得上「特别坏」。

lines.en: : That wasn’t just normal kiss territory. That was tonsil hockey territory. It was only gonna get crazier from there.
lines.zh: : 那可不止是普通亲吻的范畴。那是法式深吻的范畴。而且接下来只会越来越疯。

lines.en: : I wish it did.
lines.zh: : 我真希望它就这么疯下去。

lines.en: : Of course you wish it did. Uta-chan’s stolen your heart the way you’ve stolen a bunch of other people's.
lines.zh: : 您当然会这么想。Uta 酱偷走了您的心，就像您偷走了其他许多人的心一样。

lines.en: : And I’m guessing those people are the ones you’re talking about when you say you “wanted to make the right move for everyone?”
lines.zh: : 我猜，你说的「想做出对所有人正确的选择」，指的就是那些人吧？

lines.en: scene utakaraoke27
: Everyone means everyone.
lines.zh: : 所有人就是所有人。

lines.en: : I’m glad you think I’m cute and that you wanna kiss me and stuff, but I’m really not as great as you think I am.
lines.zh: : 您觉得我可爱、想亲我什么的，我很高兴，可我真的没有您想的那么好。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that I’m really dumb and that I’d like to be forgiven for any dumb things I do around you.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我真的很蠢，希望您能原谅我在您身边做的那些蠢事。

lines.en: : Like givin’ into that late night karaoke booth mood and gettin’ all up in your face.
lines.zh: : 比如刚才没顶住深夜卡拉 OK 包厢里的气氛，把脸都凑到您跟前去了。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke28
: Or usin’ this opportunity to invite you back to my dorm room because it would be safer in there than it is in here.
lines.zh: : 又比如借这个机会邀请您回我宿舍，因为那儿比这儿安全。

lines.en: : You are aware how that sounds, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道这听起来像什么吧？

lines.en: : Inviting someone back to your room after nearly making out with them can kind of only be interpreted one way.
lines.zh: : 跟一个人差点接吻之后邀请他回你的房间，这种事只能被理解成一种意思。

lines.en: : {i}Sensei.{/i} I don’t care how much you want to make out with me or how you interpret my invitation.
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei。{/i}不管您有多想跟我亲热、也不管您怎么理解我的邀请，我都不在乎。

lines.en: : It is now my duty as both your friend and your student to make up for invading your personal space and almost making you commit adultery.
lines.zh: : 现在，作为您的朋友、也作为您的学生，我有义务弥补我侵犯了您的私人空间、还差点让您犯了通奸之罪这一过失。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to just stay here and make out?
lines.zh: : 你确定不想就留在这儿亲热？

lines.en: scene utakaraoke27
: Can you do me a favor and not bring that up anymore?
lines.zh: : 能不能帮个忙，别再提这事了？

lines.en: : It really was just a spur of the moment thing. People do stuff like that all the time.
lines.zh: : 那真的只是一时冲动。这种事大家常常都会做。

lines.en: : It’s not like anything actually {i}happened{/i}. We just accidentally got our faces a little closer to each other than they’d ever been before.
lines.zh: : 又不是真的{i}发生了{/i}什么。我们只是不小心把脸凑得比以往任何时候都近了一点。

lines.en: : But what does that have to do with {i}everybody?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可这跟{i}所有人{/i}有什么关系？

lines.en: : Because one of my least favorite qualities in people is selflessness. Think about yourself and what you want before worrying about how anyone else feels.
lines.zh: : 因为我最讨厌人身上的一种品质，就是无私。先想想你自己、想想你想要什么，再去操心别人的感受。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不要。

lines.en: : No?
lines.zh: : 不要？

lines.en: : No. I don’t wanna.
lines.zh: : 不要。我不想。

lines.en: : I’m happy the way I am.
lines.zh: : 我现在这样就很幸福。

lines.en: : And that way involves lookin’ out for others.
lines.zh: : 而这份幸福里，包含替别人着想。

lines.en: : So, sorry...but you’ll just have to keep wackin’ it to what the Uta in your imagination does and not worry about what the real Uta does.
lines.zh: : 所以，抱歉啦……您只能继续对着想象中的 Uta 打飞机，别去操心现实里的 Uta 在干什么。

lines.en: : Cause the real Uta’s not gonna be ready for the stuff you wanna do with her for a long time.
lines.zh: : 因为现实里的 Uta，在很长一段时间里都不会准备好跟您做那些您想做的事。

lines.en: : Maybe not even ever.
lines.zh: : 也许永远都不会。

lines.en: : We’ll see about that.
lines.zh: : 这事儿走着瞧。

lines.en: scene utakaraoke29
: Is that a challenge?
lines.zh: : 这是挑战吗？

lines.en: : Are you still so excited about the dorm war that you need to start a {i}new{/i} contest just to keep the adrenaline up?
lines.zh: : 您是还对宿舍大战兴奋得不行，非得再开一场{i}新的{/i}比赛才能维持肾上腺素吗？

lines.en: : If that’s what you want to call it, sure.
lines.zh: : 你想这么叫，那就这么叫吧。

lines.en: : But I’m not going to let you forget that this happened and I am going to use it as a weapon against you whenever possible.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会让你忘了这件事的，而且只要有机会，我就会拿它当武器对付你。

lines.en: : Then I’ll just have to learn to deflect you even harder.
lines.zh: : 那我就只好学着把您挡得更彻底了。

lines.en: : Game on, Sensei. No one beats Uta.
lines.zh: : 放马过来吧，Sensei。没人赢得了 Uta。

lines.en: : We’ll see about that...
lines.zh: : 这事儿走着瞧……

lines.en: scene black
Strangely enough, Uta doesn’t retract her dorm invite and, after checking out of the karaoke place, we begin to head over there.
lines.zh: 奇怪的是，Uta 并没有收回邀请我去宿舍的话，我们结完卡拉 OK 的账，便动身往那边走。

lines.en: We’re both fully expecting Io to be around, though, so I’ve mostly given up on the prospect of pushing things any further with Uta for the time being.
lines.zh: 不过我们俩都料到 Io 会在，所以眼下我基本已经放弃跟 Uta 更进一步了。

lines.en: It is really peculiar, though.
lines.zh: 不过这真的很奇怪。

lines.en: Maybe all of those deflections really aren’t deflections at all?
lines.zh: 也许那些回避，其实根本不是回避？

lines.en: Maybe Uta {i}does{/i} want something more with me but just...isn’t pursuing it for some reason.
lines.zh: 也许 Uta {i}确实{/i}想跟我更进一步，只是……出于某种原因没有去追求。

lines.en: It’s not because of Maya, is it? Or Io?
lines.zh: 该不会是因为 Maya 吧？还是因为 Io？

lines.en: What did she mean by she’s not as great as I think she is?
lines.zh: 她说自己没有我想的那么好，到底是什么意思？

lines.en: And why does that remind me of something Io said recently?...
lines.zh: 还有，为什么这话让我想起了 Io 最近说过的某句话？……

lines.en: $ uta_love += 1
$ utamaid20 = True
{i}Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump utadorm20
